character.name:
Pixel art character of a French colonial soldier or World War-era infantryman wearing an olive green military uniform, brown leather belt, dark brown boots, and a green steel helmet. 
The soldier has a beard and a serious expression, standing in side view with relaxed arms, 8-bit retro style, top-down 2D game character, transparent background.
